Bor the Cunning

Biography

Bor the Cunning leads the Free Hunters. He thanks Kir for rescuing his men from lizards, claims neutrality and nevertheless favours the orcs against the village’s expansion. His requests draw Kir into local rivalries, including a scheme to bring Babur to the hunters’ camp through a false message. [1, 2, 3]
